items.text: 擔任全球 CRM 系統之 IT Service Desk 支援窗口（L1／L2），受理、回應並透過工單系統追蹤使用者回報的問題與服務請求。
提供美國地區應用系統（OA、SOI 等）之使用者支援，作為當地用戶與技術團隊的良好溝通橋樑。
執行基礎帳號與權限管理，依照 SOP 進行 CRM 使用者帳號開通、關閉、異動及基本權限設定。
問題初篩與升級後送（Escalation），進行第一線基本排錯（Troubleshooting），無法直接排除之問題，負責蒐集完整系統 log 與重現步驟後，轉交後端二/三線技術團隊。
維護系統知識庫（Knowledge Base），協助彙整常見問題與操作錯誤案例，更新 FAQ 與標準工單回覆範本（Standard Response）。
協助日常工單指標維護與事件配合，追蹤 SLA 時效，並於系統發生重大異常（Major Incident）時，配合技術團隊流程協助通知與進度跟進。
具備 1 年以上 IT Helpdesk、系統客服支援、或企業內部軟體維運經驗（不限特定 CRM，有 ERP / OA / 工單系統處理經驗者皆歡迎；亦歡迎具備相關實習經驗的優秀新鮮人）。
英文讀寫溝通順暢：能以英文 Email 或工單系統（Ticket）與海外用戶明確溝通問題與解法（TOEIC 650 分以上，或具備同等英文書面溝通能力）。
基礎邏輯排錯與資訊轉譯能力：熟悉基礎 IT 支援思維，能耐心聽懂「非技術用戶」的痛點，並將其準確記錄、轉化為技術團隊能理解的語言。
服務優先的同理心與耐心：具備良好的溝通態度與責任感，面對用戶的重複性詢問或緊急事件，能依循標準流程（SOP）給予與協助和安撫。
良好的時間與任務管理能力：能同時有條理地追蹤多筆工單，並能清楚分辨任務的優先順序。
Act as the primary IT Service Desk point of contact (L1/L2) for the global CRM system, receiving, responding to, and tracking user issues via the ticketing system.
Provide friendly and effective user support for US-regional applications (OA, SOI, etc.), serving as the primary liaison between local business users and IT teams.
Perform daily user account administration, including user provisioning, deactivation, role changes, and access authorization according to standard SOPs.
Conduct initial issue assessment and basic troubleshooting. For complex issues, gather necessary details (error logs, reproduction steps) and properly escalate to backend technical or product teams.
Contribute to the Knowledge Base by collecting common user questions and error cases to update FAQs, user guides, and standard response templates.
Assist in tracking Service Desk SLA metrics and support standard communication procedures during Major Incidents until resolution.

1+ years of experience in IT Helpdesk, application support, or technical customer service (Experience with any internal corporate systems, ERP, or ticketing tools is welcome; talented junior candidates or fresh grads with relevant internships will also be considered).
Working efficiency in English: Ability to communicate clearly with overseas users via email and ticketing systems (TOEIC 650+ or equivalent written/reading capability).
Logical troubleshooting and translation skills: Ability to understand non-technical users' pain points, perform basic root-cause isolation, and accurately document issues for technical teams.
Customer-first mindset: Patient, empathetic, and accountable. Able to handle repetitive requests or urgent issues calmly while following established procedures.
Good time management: Capable of multitasking, prioritizing open tickets, and following up proactively.

description.text:
【主要工作內容 / Key Responsibilities】
1. 擔任全球 CRM 系統之 IT Service Desk 支援窗口（L1／L2），受理、回應並透過工單系統追蹤使用者回報的問題與服務請求。

3. 執行基礎帳號與權限管理，依照 SOP 進行 CRM 使用者帳號開通、關閉、異動及基本權限設定。
4. 問題初篩與升級後送（Escalation），進行第一線基本排錯（Troubleshooting），無法直接排除之問題，負責蒐集完整系統 log 與重現步驟後，轉交後端二/三線技術團隊。

6. 協助日常工單指標維護與事件配合，追蹤 SLA 時效，並於系統發生重大異常（Major Incident）時，配合技術團隊流程協助通知與進度跟進。
【必要條件 / Required Qualifications】
1. 具備 1 年以上 IT Helpdesk、系統客服支援、或企業內部軟體維運經驗（不限特定 CRM，有 ERP / OA / 工單系統處理經驗者皆歡迎；亦歡迎具備相關實習經驗的優秀新鮮人）。
2. 英文讀寫溝通順暢：能以英文 Email 或工單系統（Ticket）與海外用戶明確溝通問題與解法（TOEIC 650 分以上，或具備同等英文書面溝通能力）。
3. 基礎邏輯排錯與資訊轉譯能力：熟悉基礎 IT 支援思維，能耐心聽懂「非技術用戶」的痛點，並將其準確記錄、轉化為技術團隊能理解的語言。
4. 服務優先的同理心與耐心：具備良好的溝通態度與責任感，面對用戶的重複性詢問或緊急事件，能依循標準流程（SOP）給予與協助和安撫。
5. 良好的時間與任務管理能力：能同時有條理地追蹤多筆工單，並能清楚分辨任務的優先順序。
【Key Responsibilities】
1. Act as the primary IT Service Desk point of contact (L1/L2) for the global CRM system, receiving, responding to, and tracking user issues via the ticketing system.
2. Provide friendly and effective user support for US-regional applications (OA, SOI, etc.), serving as the primary liaison between local business users and IT teams.
3. Perform daily user account administration, including user provisioning, deactivation, role changes, and access authorization according to standard SOPs.
4. Conduct initial issue assessment and basic troubleshooting. For complex issues, gather necessary details (error logs, reproduction steps) and properly escalate to backend technical or product teams.
5. Contribute to the Knowledge Base by collecting common user questions and error cases to update FAQs, user guides, and standard response templates.
6. Assist in tracking Service Desk SLA metrics and support standard communication procedures during Major Incidents until resolution.
【Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)】
1. 1+ years of experience in IT Helpdesk, application support, or technical customer service (Experience with any internal corporate systems, ERP, or ticketing tools is welcome; talented junior candidates or fresh grads with relevant internships will also be considered).
2. Working efficiency in English: Ability to communicate clearly with overseas users via email and ticketing systems (TOEIC 650+ or equivalent written/reading capability).
3. Logical troubleshooting and translation skills: Ability to understand non-technical users' pain points, perform basic root-cause isolation, and accurately document issues for technical teams.
4. Customer-first mindset: Patient, empathetic, and accountable. Able to handle repetitive requests or urgent issues calmly while following established procedures.
5. Good time management: Capable of multitasking, prioritizing open tickets, and following up proactively.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
【加分條件 / Preferred Qualifications】
1. 曾接觸或操作過 Microsoft Dynamics 365、Salesforce 或其他知名商用 CRM／ERP 系統者尤佳。
2. 具備 3 年以上企業級 IT 支援經驗者（將優先列入 L2 核心工程師或管理儲備評估）。
3. 熟悉 Jira、ServiceNow、Zendesk 等工單管理系統流程（Incident / Request / SLA 管理）。
4. TOEIC 750 分以上，或能以全英文參與跨國語音/視訊會議進行問題排除者優先加分。
【Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)】
1. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or other enterprise CRM/ERP platforms.
2. 3+ years of experience in enterprise system support (Candidates with extensive experience will be fast-tracked for L2/Senior responsibilities).
3. Familiarity with ITIL processes and ticketing tools like Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk.
4. TOEIC 750+ or conversational fluency in spoken English for joining real-time troubleshooting calls with US teams.
